summary: Frontend-only test of collapsible platform categories on Home page (#platforms) for logged-in members. All acceptance criteria met: 8 categories render, all collapsed by default, click header toggles grid visibility and rotates chevron 180deg, multiple categories toggle independently, quick-nav chips expand target category AND scroll into view, logged-out users still see the locked/donate card.
critical_code_review_comments: Quick-nav category chips have NO data-testid (e.g. data-testid='quicknav-chip-<id>'). Only the toggle buttons and grids are testable. Adding testids to chips would make future automation more robust.
Two buttons in #platforms contain identical text like 'Freelancing' (chip + toggle) with no testid on the chip — locator disambiguation currently relies on DOM order. Recommend testids on chips.
Card CTA reads 'Learn More', not 'Visit' as described in the review request — cosmetic mismatch with the spec's wording but existing behavior, unrelated to the collapsible feature.
test_credentials: Member verify URL was consumed during first run; regenerated via POST /api/cms/login (admin/Gulluk*9) + POST /api/cms/get-verify-link {email: pillartest@incomeonline.info}. New verify URL: /verify?token=a14df440-7bec-4b81-b828-c6d718b6f848 (also single-use; regenerate as needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 8 categories are toggle-1..toggle-8. Category slugs use lowercase + spaces->-, &->and (e.g. cat-e-commerce, cat-surveys-and-research). Quick-nav chips at top of #platforms are the FIRST 8 buttons; the next 8 buttons are the category-toggle-<id> headers. When testing chips, use `.first` on `#platforms button:has-text(...)` because both chip and toggle contain the same category label. Verify link is single-use — always regenerate via admin login before running new browser sessions.
verified_behaviors: Default state: 8 category-toggle-* buttons rendered, 0 category-grid-* elements present (all collapsed).
Click toggle → grid appears, chevron gets 'rotate-180' class, label switches 'Click to view' → 'Click to hide'.
Click again → grid removed from DOM (collapsed).
Independent toggling: expanding cat 1 and cat 3 simultaneously — both grids visible.
Quick-nav chip 'Freelancing' → category-grid-1 becomes visible, cat-freelancing anchor scrolled to top:80px (in viewport).
Quick-nav chip 'E-commerce' → category-grid-5 becomes visible, cat-e-commerce scrolled to top:80px (in viewport).
Platform cards render name, star rating, Featured badge, description, earning range, difficulty, min payout, and a 'Learn More' CTA.
Logged-out home page: 0 category-toggle-* buttons, 'Donate to Unlock/Donate Now' locked card visible instead.
